verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB says each agent run can get its own branch of production data on isolated compute, which can be experimented on and then discarded [docs-13]. It also offers isolated read-only agent compute that can't affect production traffic [docs-12], a free dev instance [docs-10], and CHKit commands to test schema and pipelines in CI [docs-11]. All of this comes from homepage marketing claims rather than detailed documentation. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how branches are created and how writes are isolated from production, and independent or hands-on corroboration that branching works as claimed.
